source_review.notes: Reviewed current PostgreSQL nbtsearch implementation and nbtree design notes plus current index-scanning, ordering, and multicolumn documentation; official SQLite query-planning documentation; current MySQL 8.4 index guidance; Lehman-Yao; Graefe; and the cited textbook. Seven online destinations returned HTTP 200. The intended current MySQL and Microsoft Graefe destinations returned automated-access HTTP 403; MySQL remained research-index readable. Product behavior is version scoped.
